record.student_summary: You can do your summer software internship as CPT once your department confirms it counts for credit and your I-20 is extended to December 15, 2027 for your thesis. Get the CPT on your I-20 before you start work. You can visit Ghana over winter break with a travel signature, but your visa must be valid when you return — renew it abroad if needed. One summer of full-time CPT should still leave you able to do OPT after graduation.
